title: Guardrail rule engine + audit logging layer
context: This is the core 'bounded and gated' requirement from the track brief, and the highest-scrutiny piece for judges. Escalate to Opus given correctness/explainability stakes.
objective: Build a deterministic (non-LLM) rule engine enforcing: max discount %, max single-order value, max quantity per line item. Every check writes an AuditEntry, whether it passes or fails.
scope_in: Rule config object: max_discount_pct, max_order_value, max_qty_per_item — hardcoded constants, documented in code comments as demo-scope values
Rule engine runs on every create and update call before persisting
On violation: session.status = rejected, AuditEntry written with action=reject and a human-readable reason string (e.g. 'Discount 25% exceeds max allowed 15%')
On pass: AuditEntry still written with action=create or update, reason=null
scope_out: No LLM-based judgment anywhere in this rule engine — must be deterministic and unit-testable
acceptance_criteria: A request with quantity or discount within bounds succeeds normally
A request exceeding max_discount_pct is rejected with a reason string naming the exact rule violated
A request exceeding max_order_value is rejected with a reason string naming the exact rule violated
Every single rule check (pass or fail) produces exactly one AuditEntry — verified via a test asserting Firestore write count
No network/LLM call exists anywhere in the rule evaluation path — verified by code review
